Traditionally, it's just pumpkin, milk or cream, evaporated milk (some recipes use condensed, but I find those kind of cloying), sugar, eggs, and "pumpkin pie spices," which are a combination of cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and ginger. Some people add allspice. Some people (including me) add these spices separately according to taste, but you can also buy them premixed in tubs/tins/jars as, well, "Pumpkin Pie Spice," at any grocery store.

Nuts, maple syrup, cream cheese, chocolate, coffee, all that stuff, can make delicious variations and some people love them, but the basic traditional pumpkin pie doesn't include any of it.
